projects.method: Authenticated browser description-editor saves, server reloads and exact Markdown readback. All six existing descriptions retain their complete original criteria/history as an unchanged suffix. One independent-update-authentication draft was added with Todo/Roadmap fields. Live DOM readback covered all three saved views and 43 unique titles. No issue conversation comments or public issues were created.

updatedItems.title: [P1] Independently authenticate update metadata and packages
[P2] Add a separate document sanitization tool and security model
[P2] Add certificate trust, revocation and trusted timestamp verification
[P2] Improve redaction precision, persistent marks and before/after preview
[P2] Convert local Office documents to PDF and reuse conversion profiles
[P1] Fuzz PDF and CMS boundaries and publish hardware benchmarks
[P1] Resolve the 117 Code Scanning alerts for 0.21.0

screenshot.exportLimitation: Browser URL policy refused data-URL navigation for an image export. No workaround was attempted. The recorded proof uses saved Markdown readback and the live DOM view inventories.

projects.limits: The independent publication key is unavailable; its new Roadmap item remains Todo. Existing P1 hardware, signing, conformance and broad-fuzzing criteria remain open. Done statuses refer to their bounded delivered scope and retain all original criteria/history.

limits: No independent publication key or signed update metadata: distribution still trusts GitHub HTTPS and same-channel checksums.
Windows packages remain unsigned; ARM64 is cross-built only.
Physical printers, manual GUI/update flows, Narrator and physical GPU behavior remain separate QA.
No PDF/A/PDF/UA or archival LTV certification.
An isolated forged-CRL native experiment was not performed. Strong CRL/OCSP policy and default Windows trust roots remain in force; no bypass was confirmed by read-only review.
ODF conditional expressions are refused by the input guard; execution/network exploitation through a local converter was not claimed or tested.
delivery: Commit delivery used the owner's existing branch-rule bypass; exact-source main and tag CI qualified the public release.
